extracted.name: Crab & beetroot pâté
extracted.description: Pair beetroot with crab to make this healthy and vibrant pâté. Serve with crudités and crisp breads for dunking
ingredient_lines: ½ small bunch dill finely chopped
½ small bunch parsley finely chopped
350g baby cucumber halved (or 1 cucumber, cut into matchsticks), to serve
instruction_lines: Mix together the crabmeat, beetroot, crème fraîche, lemon zest and juice, dill and parsley. Season with black pepper.
Blanch the runner beans in boiling water for 1 min, then drain and cool in iced water. Serve the pâté with the veg and the vegetables and crispbreads for dunking, if you like.
